integrity: Full deterministic C++17 enumeration and direct small Python checker accompany the proof. Modular evaluation is used only as an implication-preserving separation witness; no probability, floating-point tolerance, external certification or independence is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Computer-assisted exact finite classification of fourth principal specialization for four-spine caterpillars with at most 200 vertices. No result for larger orders or other spine lengths; no proof of the general caterpillar conjecture. Historical priority and independent mathematical validation remain outstanding.
title: Finite four-spine caterpillar separation by two chromatic specialization values
